articles.title: Google is working on Plugins for Gemini Enterprise
articles.summary: Google appears to be developing Plugins and a dedicated Notifications area for Gemini Enterprise, according to unfinished interface elements. Plugins may package reusable Skills and Connectors into multi-step workplace workflows, while Notifications would collect completed results from background tasks. Google has not announced either feature or provided a rollout timeline.

articles.title: Feds get 3 days to patch N-able God mode flaw under active exploit
articles.summary: CISA has ordered federal agencies to patch an actively exploited N-able N-central vulnerability that can give attackers remote administrative access to an MSP's management console. Successful attacks have allowed access to managed customer systems and the creation of persistent Cloudflare tunnels. All versions before N-central 2026.3.1.7 are affected.

articles.title: AWS Is Failing Fast. Can Its Customers Keep Up?
articles.summary: AWS has placed Amazon Q Business, Amazon Kendra, Bedrock Agents Classic, and nine SageMaker AI capabilities into maintenance mode, blocking new customers while continuing access and support for existing users. This is a rational portfolio correction driven by changing technology and adoption, but AWS can reallocate resources faster than enterprise customers can migrate from services in which they have invested.

articles.title: Your team isn't ignoring security. They're just underwater
articles.summary: Cloud security tools can generate more findings than teams can realistically address, leaving vulnerabilities and misconfigurations open despite plenty of visibility. The article recommends a recurring triage process with clear ownership and business context to prioritize meaningful risks and keep remediation moving.

articles.title: The enterprise AI strategy that outlasts any single model
articles.summary: Enterprises should avoid tying their AI strategy to a single provider as models, capabilities, and pricing continue to leapfrog one another. A model-agnostic architecture that can swap underlying models and compound improvements at the system level would allow organizations to benefit from advances across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others.

articles.title: Sixb: the operating layer for enterprise AI
articles.summary: Sixb introduces an operational framework for enterprise AI that connects business data, models, rules, permissions, and workflows in a shared environment for teams and AI agents. The framework is intended to let agents act within controlled business processes rather than merely answer prompted questions. Version 0.1.0 includes data connectors, automation, agent tooling, security controls, storage options, and custom application support.

articles.title: SnapLogic introduces agentic assistant for data integration
articles.summary: SnapLogic has upgraded SnapGPT from an integration copilot into an agentic assistant that can plan, build, explain, validate, and troubleshoot enterprise data integrations through natural language. The assistant also provides administrators with activity logs and production monitoring insights for AI-assisted integration work.

articles.title: Removing the Security Barrier to Agentforce Adoption
articles.summary: Salesforce's Private Connect platform removes a security and connectivity barrier to enterprise adoption of Agentforce and other services by providing audited, encrypted private paths that avoid the public internet. Architectural redesigns and automation reduced provisioning from weeks to under 30 minutes. The platform now handles approximately 120 TB of data and 683 million requests monthly across 15 AWS regions.

articles.title: AI agents get better at IT ops, but only with humans in the loop
articles.summary: A study of nearly 150,000 agent actions across 40 companies found AI now performs about one-third of IT workflow actions, primarily routine and reversible tasks, while humans retain control over higher-risk decisions. Agent performance improved through repeated human feedback, but identity, onboarding, and offboarding tasks failed most often because of outdated data, missing accounts, and unreliable integrations.

articles.title: Google Workspace Plugins: Cursor
articles.summary: Cursor has launched plugins that let users read, write, and take actions across Google Workspace without leaving Cursor.

articles.title: Redefining Network Security for the Frontier AI Era
articles.summary: Palo Alto Networks launched PAN-OS 12.2 Ceres with advanced virtual patching, proactive IP-layer defense, six network administration agents, quantum-safe security capabilities, and new high-performance firewalls.
